text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the curtains finally rise on the 
Arima Kinen! Among these handpicked 
Umamusume, the one drawing the most 
attention is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Grass Wonder, the "Monster" himself!! 
We cannot take our eyes off the battle 
with his destined rival, Special Week!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I feel very calm. A clear, serene 
state of mind, one might say.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I just can't wait for the gates 
to open.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...To those who run on the same turf with 
me, I offer my gratitude and respect."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Knowing that, I will move forward.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'll win... Because I'm the one who's 
going to win!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Let's compete, with everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...You certainly look like you're having 
fun. Just remember, I'm the one who's 
going to defeat you.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I will not forgive you if you lose here, 
mi monstruo.

—At last, the fanfare for the Arima Kinen 
sounds!
